info.title: HitPipe MVP HTTP boundaries
info.description: HP-FORMAL-001 canonical wire source. Product HP-VER-001 candidate. Human session+CSRF same-origin at BFF; internal mTLS service identity AND current IAM scope at actual gates. BP007 owns durable request identity/response/error rules. No schema proves business/HTTP behavior by itself.

Error.description: No secrets or other-workspace existence in error text. Unknown fields fail closed.

CommandMeta.description: Expected revision mandatory for existing mutable aggregate; header If-Match must agree if present. Stable request ID plus body digest defines command identity.

ConnectorCreate.description: MVP owner-installed dedicated Stripe restricted key / ClickUp dedicated service account token; verified account identity, sufficient real rights and explicit scope before Ready. Secrets never echoed.

ContextCommand.description: Server assigns actual added_at/expires_at, rejects supplied extension beyond90d; total UTF8 serialized business context <=32KiB. Provider/query/export URL fields are not fetched.

AIRequest.description: No user/workspace/provider/order identifiers or credentials in payload, metadata or provider trace. Alias mapping stays Go-side. External model payload has no X-HitPipe-Session. Internal Python endpoint requires opaque session plus control context and fresh IAM authorization before model send.

AuthorizedAIRequest.description: INTERNAL only. Python verifies fresh IAM permission using opaque session over private mTLS; control IDs/session NEVER enter model payload/headers/metadata/logs. Sole provider payload is request editor/aliases/synthetic data after guard.

NormalizedSignal.description: Minimal whitelist; no arbitrary metadata, customer/contact/brief. Event signature verified before durable intake, same account+mode bounded and immutable. Digest computed over canonical payload excluding message_digest.

SourceFacts.description: Unknown is explicit and NEVER permission. full strict guard in BP002/BP003. Valid_until <=oldest mandatory fact+10s. Snapshot cannot make Stripe/ClickUp atomic.

DeliveryIntent.description: Only verified accepted config mappings; serialized context <=32KiB. Stable lineage independent of episode. Not a provider idempotency key. Delivery cannot invent business config/case state.

TaskObservation.description: Task ID alone is not confirmation. Full destination GET and all required matches true+complete needed. Empty search is never proof of no effect.

Health.description: Liveness is not customer business readiness or achieved SLO.
